1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto de hasta 4 m de altura, de corteza color rojo oscuro, follaje verdinegro, hojas elípticas y lustrosas y flores amarillas de gran tamaño; la madera de color castaño oliva o verde amarillento se utiliza en ebanistería. Annonaceae Asimina blainii.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Shrub reaching a height of up to 4 m, with dark reddish-brown bark, verdinegreen foliage, elliptical and glossy leaves, and large yellow flowers; the wood, ranging in color from olive brown to yellow-green, is used in cabinetry. Annonaceae Asimina blainii.
